prompt: Under what circumstances will a supervisory authority actually fine us versus just ordering us to fix things?
assertions: Cites EDPB Guidelines 04/2026 on administrative fines in relation to other corrective powers (adopted at the September 2026 plenary; consultation open to November 13)
Describes the five-step methodology for deciding whether a fine is appropriate at all

States that fines are not automatic: the guidelines map the full Art. 58(2) corrective toolbox (warnings, reprimands, compliance orders, bans, certification withdrawal) and when each applies alone or with a fine
Mentions the harmonisation intent (14 practical examples; consistent DPA practice across the EEA)
Connects to the existing fining-calculation guidelines (04/2022 methodology) as the separate quantum step
